sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.
The applicant has filed this eighth bail application u/S. 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

Applicant has been arrested on 02.02.2021 in connection with Crime No.12/2021 registered at Police Station:
Bagchini, District Morena for the offence punishable under Sections 304, 420, 465, 468, 470, 471,
473, 201 and 34 of IPC and Section 34 and 49A of Excise Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant pressed for temporary bail to attend marriage of niece of applicant as she is likely to be wedded on 26.02.2024.

Being uncle, he has to participate in many Satish Shivhare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/50833397/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: rituals therefore, he sought 15 days' period for interim bail.
Marriage card is attached with the application.
Thus, prayed for temporary bail.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent/State verified the fact and submitted that niece of applicant is going to be wedded on 26.02.2024.
However, he opposed the prayer for 15 days.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
5.
Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and on the basis of verification and the fact of marriage of niece of applicant, this Court allows the application for temporary bail.

6. It is hereby directed that the applicant shall be released on 20.02.2024 and shall enjoy interim bail till 28.02.2024 on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount in which one should be cash surety to the satisfaction of trial Court.
The applicant shall have to surrender on or before 29.02.2024 before the trial Court.
Surrender report shall be submitted by the concerned Court to the Office of this Court for information.
